question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

Rhythmic flow of sounds or words.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Cadence'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the question "Rhythmic flow of sounds or words", the answer is **Cadence.**
 
• **Cadence** is a modulation or inflection of the voice or a sequence of notes or chords comprising the close of a musical phrase.(लय)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Cadence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Credence **(विश्वास) means belief in or acceptance of something as true.
 
• **Crescents **(अर्धचंद्राकार) means something shaped like a crescent, particularly the waxing or waning moon.
 
• **Copious **(प्रचुर) means abundant in supply or quantity.
